## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/), such as `feat: add the run command`.

- [ ] `npm run check` and `npm test` pass.

- [ ] The README describes any change a user can see.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` and the version in `package.json` are unchanged. The release pull request writes them.
